raw_output: {"weekly_mirror":"This week held a small, concrete moment of enjoyment: after the grocery run, you stayed for laksa despite the queue, telling yourself, “five more...” At the same time, the wish to have tea with something sweet was still interrupted by laundry, while your Sunday visit with Ma included two hours of care and attention.","tension_explanation":"Last week, rest and pleasure were crowded out by cleaning and the voice saying not to be “so pampered.” This week does not show that same pattern continuing in every moment, though the café-like pause you wanted remained unfinished; what made it possible to linger over the laksa, but not the tea and treat, remains open.","reflective_question":"What feels different between the moments when you let yourself stay for something enjoyable and the moments when you move on before you can enjoy it?"}

narrative.weekly_mirror: This week held a small, concrete moment of enjoyment: after the grocery run, you stayed for laksa despite the queue, telling yourself, “five more...” At the same time, the wish to have tea with something sweet was still interrupted by laundry, while your Sunday visit with Ma included two hours of care and attention.
narrative.tension_explanation: Last week, rest and pleasure were crowded out by cleaning and the voice saying not to be “so pampered.” This week does not show that same pattern continuing in every moment, though the café-like pause you wanted remained unfinished; what made it possible to linger over the laksa, but not the tea and treat, remains open.
narrative.reflective_question: What feels different between the moments when you let yourself stay for something enjoyable and the moments when you move on before you can enjoy it?
